display_title: Vergunning windpark IJmuiden Ver Gamma-B – Windenergie op zee (Wet windenergie op zee)
organization_or_parent_framework: Dutch Ministry of Climate Policy and Green Growth (executed by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency, RVO)
programme: Windenergie op zee (Wet windenergie op zee)
executive_summary: A tender for the permit to build and operate a roughly 1 GW offshore wind farm on lot Gamma-B in the IJmuiden Ver wind area, about 61 km off the Dutch coast, with an SDE++-type operating subsidy (payment for the unprofitable part of the electricity price over 15 years); applicants may alternatively bid without subsidy in an auction. The maximum subsidy is EUR 4.698 billion and the maximum tender amount EUR 0.116 per kWh; the lowest tender amount wins. Wind farm developers and energy companies can apply from 2026-11-26 to 2026-12-10 at 17:00. Gamma-B connects to the same TenneT 2 GW platform as Gamma-A, which is tendered in parallel under its own regulation.
status_rationale: The RVO scheme page (Hoeveel subsidie, Voorwaarden) and the Gamma-B regulation (Staatscourant 2026, 21303), read alongside the parallel Gamma-A rules in Staatscourant 2026, 21297, offer a permit with a 15-year operating subsidy to the best bid. TenneT connects Gamma-B to the same direct-current platform as Gamma-A and delivers the grid on a fixed schedule, so the call decides when its second 1 GW is used (Q&A Gamma-B, Ontwikkelkader). TenneT cannot apply as the permit and subsidy go to wind farm developers and energy companies. Type 3 is the closest label, but none of the C3 categories describes grid-connected generation, so C3.3 (better use of connections) is the nearest fit. The call states no project start or end date, so both are null.
